intro.text: The man who founded the Shu-Dereth faith.

items.text: Long ago, Dereth lived in JinDo, where he and Korath were disciples of Keseg, whose teachings on unity became Shu-Keseg. When the two left JinDo to preach in the north, each read Keseg's message in his own way, and their teachings became Shu-Dereth and Shu-Korath. For Dereth, unity was something people reached by obeying.
